ns2:course.label: Real Estate Economics
ns2:course.description: Discusses the theory and practice of real estate and urban land economics; emphasizes real estate market analysis, finance, appraisal, and investment. Prerequisite: FIN 520, plus ECON 302, ECON 500, or equivalent; or MBA 505 - Section G ( Finance II); or consent of instructor.
